escenas.texto: This week in Europe, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and fifty-five million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, SEEDPIT Official, with “Seed moved out part 2”. Over seven point eight million views. A Short of just forty-eight seconds. It also has six hundred and seventeen comments.

At number nine, from Türkiye, Silent Spark, with “Backyard Renovation Timelapse: Wooden Shed, Garden, and Landscaping”. Over eight point one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has one hundred and eighty-four comments.

In position number eight, from Austria, Red Bull, with “No, You Couldn't Do This”. Over nine point four million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over two thousand comments.
In position number seven, from France, Kivenro, with a video posted six days ago. Over nine point five million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has two hundred and one comments.
In position number six, from United Kingdom, YANA CHIRKINA, with “we tried to draw the perfect heart”. Over eleven million views. A Short of just twenty-six seconds. It also has sixty-five comments.
Number five, from France, Mayamystic, with “OH NO, we lost Pinkie Pie’s tail”. Over twelve million views. A Short of just fifteen seconds. It also has five hundred and twenty-nine comments.
Next up, number four, from United Kingdom, Futcrunch, with “Can I Find Neymar?”. Over thirteen million views. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds. It also has one hundred and twenty-three comments.

Bronze medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted five days ago. Over thirteen million views. A video over twenty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over six thousand comments.
Silver medal, from United Kingdom, Amazon MGM Studios, with “The Thomas Crown Affair Official Trailer”. Over fifteen million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, Bipoumi, with “Comment ALARM if you want your kids to stay safe!”. Over thirty-three million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from Ukraine, itpedia, with a video posted one day ago. Over four thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over one point four million views.

At number nine, from Spain, DaniRep | +6 Vídeos Diarios De GTA 5 Online!, with a video posted one day ago. Over five thousand comments. A video over twenty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

Coming in at number eight, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a video posted two days ago. Over five thousand comments. A video over forty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Number seven, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a video posted three days ago. Over five thousand comments. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one point four million views.

Coming in at number six, from United Kingdom, TinyDude, with “How to unlock everything in rivals biggest free update!”. Over six thousand comments. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five hundred and sixty-one thousand views.

Number five, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted five days ago. Over six thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ten thousand views per hour. A video over twenty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Coming in at number four, from Sweden, Minecraft, with “New weapon and off-hand for bedrock! twitchcon san diego”. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over two point five million views.
Bronze medal, from Spain, Tecnonauta, with a video posted four days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over one point five million views.

Silver medal, from United Kingdom, Sidemen, with “Sidemen murder mystery dinner”. Over twelve thousand comments. A video over one hundred and twelve minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

And here it is. Number one most commented, from Türkiye, Remzi Kamalak, with a video posted six days ago. Over twelve thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nine out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Spain, Rubius Z, with a video posted two days ago. Over ninety-three thousand likes. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Coming in at number nine, from Türkiye, Silent Spark, with “Backyard Renovation Timelapse: Wooden Shed, Garden, and Landscaping”. Over one hundred thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over eight point one million views.

At number eight, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a video posted three days ago. Over one hundred thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

At number seven, Bipoumi, with “Comment ALARM if you want your kids to stay safe!”. Over one hundred and fourteen thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
Next up, number six, from Spain, Gufy Green, with a video posted six days ago. Over one hundred and seventy-five thousand likes. It also has over four point eight million views.
Coming in at number five, AI katha, with a video posted six days ago. Over one hundred and eighty-two thousand likes. It also has over four point nine million views.

In position number four, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted five days ago. Over one hundred and eighty-three thousand likes. A video over twenty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirteen million views.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Sidemen, with “Sidemen murder mystery dinner”. Over two hundred and twenty thousand likes. A video over one hundred and twelve minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Silver medal, from Austria, Red Bull, with “No, You Couldn't Do This”. Over two hundred and sixty-nine thousand likes. It also has over nine point four million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most liked, Combatful, with a video posted four days ago. Over two hundred and eighty-three thousand likes. A Short of just fifty seconds. It also has over five point six million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
